title: hashr hai aalam me bapa haaye haaye
body:
hashr hai aalam me bapa haaye haaye
hogayi jafar pe jafa haaye haaye
dedia mansoor ne sadiq ko zehr
sheh ne ki dunya se qaza haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj hue moosie kazim yateem
baap ka sadma hai bada haaye haaye
karti hai bewa yahi ro ro ke bain
raaj mera aaj luta haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
chain na hazrat ko mila ek dam
sehte rahe zulmo jafa haaye haaye
haal yateemo ka hai gham se tabaah
karte hai sab aaho buka haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
ghar hua veeraan madina luta
raah numa qatl hua haaye haaye
